overview_description.description: Neon offers a serverless PostgreSQL architecture that separates storage and compute resources, enhancing scalability for applications. This open-source solution provides developers with flexibility and transparency, allowing them to manage their databases without the complexities of traditional systems. By leveraging a management-free environment, Neon enables faster application development, helping teams streamline their workflows. The platform is designed to support various data-driven projects while ensuring efficient resource utilization. Overall, Neon serves as a practical choice for developers seeking a modern database solution that simplifies operations and fosters innovation.

about_short_description.short_description: Neon is a software development company specializing in open-source cloud-native PostgreSQL database solutions.

product.name: Neon Serverless Postgres
product.description: A managed, cloud-based PostgreSQL platform with instant provisioning, autoscaling, scale-to-zero compute, copy-on-write storage, read replicas, and point-in-time recovery.

product.name: Neon Branching
product.description: A database branching service that creates isolated PostgreSQL copies of data and schema using copy-on-write storage for development, testing, CI/CD, recovery, and analysis.

product.name: Neon Serverless Driver
product.description: A driver and client library for querying Neon PostgreSQL databases over HTTP, designed for applications running in serverless and edge environments.

product.name: Neon API and CLI
product.description: Programmatic management interfaces for creating, configuring, branching, and operating Neon PostgreSQL projects and databases at scale.

product.name: Neon for Agents
product.description: A database provisioning and management offering for AI agents that uses the Neon API to create, clone, version, and automatically suspend PostgreSQL databases.

product.name: Neon Data Migration Tools
product.description: Tools for importing existing data into Neon PostgreSQL, supporting migration from other database environments into the managed Neon platform.
